mapper.select: INSERT INTO tb_m1_info_point ( blk_sq, cust_sq, site_sq, use_cd, loc_lng, loc_lat, ins_dt, upd_dt ) VALUES ( (SELECT blk_sq FROM tb_m1_info_block WHERE blk_nm = #{blkNm}), #{custSq}, (SELECT site_sq FROM tb_m1_info_site WHERE site_nm = #{siteNm}), 1, #{locLng} , #{locLat}, now(), now() ) RETURNING point_sq

UPDATE tb_m1_info_point SET blk_sq = (SELECT blk_sq FROM tb_m1_info_block WHERE blk_nm = #{blkNm}), site_sq = (SELECT site_sq FROM tb_m1_info_site WHERE site_nm = #{siteNm}), loc_lng = #{locLng}, loc_lat = #{locLat}, upd_dt = now() WHERE cust_sq = #{custSq} RETURNING point_sq
